description: Gives all allies in the room Wide Guard status, blocking multi-target moves for one turn.
range: All allies in room, including user

name: Vital Throw
description: User receives the Vital Throw status, causing adjacent attackers to be thrown backward if they damage the user.

name: Reflect Type
description: Changes the user's types to match those of an adjacent target.

name: Heavy Slam
description: Damages an enemy. Power increases the heavier the user is compared to the target.

name: Dragon Pulse
description: Damages an enemy. Cuts corners.

name: Dragon Dance
description: Boosts user's Attack and Speed by one level each.

name: Waterfall
description: Damages an enemy and has a 20% chance of causing them to flinch.

name: Dazzling Gleam
description: Damages all adjacent enemies. Cuts corners.

name: Teeter Dance
description: Confuses all enemies and allies in the room.
range: All enemies and allies in room

name: Powder Snow
description: Damages all enemies in the room.

name: Fake Tears
description: Lowers an enemy's Special Defense by two levels.

name: Lovely Kiss
description: Puts all adjacent enemies to sleep.

name: Shock Wave
description: Damages all adjacent enemies. Never misses.

name: Lava Plume
description: Damages all adjacent enemies and has a 30% chance of burning each of them.

name: Sunny Day
description: Changes the floor's weather to Sunny.

name: Vise Grip
description: Damages an enemy.

name: Submission
description: Damages an enemy, but inflicts 1/4 recoil.

name: Work Up
description: Boosts the user's Attack and Special Attack stats by one level each.

name: Baby-Doll Eyes
description: Lowers an enemy's Attack by one level.

name: Liquidation
description: Damages an enemy and has a 20% chance of lowering their Defense by one level.

name: Rock Slide
description: Damages an enemy and has a 30% chance of causing them to flinch.

name: Block
description: Causes an enemy to become Stuck. Does not affect Ghost-type Pokemon.

name: High Horsepower
description: Damages an enemy.

name: Overheat
description: Greatly damages all adjacent enemies, but then lowers user's Special Attack by two levels. Cuts corners.

name: Psystrike
description: Damages an enemy using their physical Defense for damage calculation.

name: Dragon Tail
description: Damages an adjacent enemy, then throws them backward up to 5 tiles. If the thrown Pokémon collides with something, they take damage again.

name: Dragon Rush
description: Damages an enemy and has a 20% chance of causing them to flinch. Deals 2x damage on minimized enemies and always hits.

name: Curse
description: If user is Ghost-type, user loses half of their HP to place a curse on an enemy, causing all attacks made against them to be critical hits. Otherwise lowers user's Speed by one level and raises Attack and Defense by one level.

name: Yawn
description: Makes an enemy Drowsy, making them fall asleep after 3 turns. Never misses.

name: Electric Terrain
description: Starts Electric Terrain in the dungeon for 10-20 turns, boosting Electric moves by 30% for grounded Pokémon and preventing them from falling asleep.

name: Magnet Rise
description: Levitates the user for 5 turns, granting immunity to Ground-type attacks.

name: Lock-On
description: Guarantees that the user's next attack against the target will not miss no matter what.

name: Uproar
description: Damages all enemies in the room and inflicts Sleepless status on all Pokémon in the room.

name: Acupressure
description: Targets all allies in the room, randomly raising one of their stats by one or two levels.
range: All allies in room, including user

name: Sheer Cold
description: Defeats an enemy instantly. Very inaccurate. Can only be used if user's Speed is greater than the target, and accuracy depends on how much greater the user's Speed is.

name: Aqua Ring
description: Doubles user's HP regeneration for the floor.

name: Dive
description: Dives underwater, becoming invulnerable to most moves, then attacks on the next turn.

name: Minimize
description: Raises user's Evasion by two levels, but gives them Minimized status, which causes them to take more damage from certain moves.

name: Memento
description: The user faints instantly. Drops all stats of every enemy in the room their minimum.

name: Whirlpool
description: Traps target for 2-5 turns, dealing damage each turn. Deals double damage against Diving targets and forces them out of the dive.

name: Perish Song
description: Attempts to inflict Perishing status on all Pokémon on the floor, causing them to faint in 5 turns.

name: Counter
description: Allows user to counter Physical attacks made against them for a short time, reflecting half of the damage back to the attacker.

name: Night Shade
description: Deals damage to all adjacent enemies equal to user's level.

name: Destiny Bond
description: Grants user Destiny Bond status. If user is defeated by an attack within a few turns, the attacker faints too.

name: Dream Eater
description: Damages an enemy, but only if they are sleeping. Heals user for half the damage inflicted.

name: Focus Punch
description: User begins focusing, then massively damages an enemy on the next turn. Fails if hit by a damaging move while focusing.

name: Flail
description: Damages an enemy. Power increases the lower the user's HP is.

name: Guillotine
description: Defeats an enemy instantly. Very inaccurate. Can only be used if user's Speed is greater than the target, and accuracy depends on how much greater the user's Speed is. Always fails on Ghost-types.

name: Magnetic Flux
description: Raises Defense and Special Defense of all Electric-type Pokémon in the room by one level each.

name: Mirror Coat
description: Allows user to counter Special attacks made against them for a short time, reflecting half of the damage back to the attacker.

name: Endure
description: Grants user Endure status, where they will endure otherwise fatal attacks with 1 HP. Failure rate increases the more this move is used.

name: High Jump Kick
description: Damages an enemy. User loses half of their max HP as crash damage if it misses or is blocked.

name: Axe Kick
description: Damages an enemy and has a 30% chance of confusing them. User loses half of their max HP as crash damage if it misses or is blocked.

name: Power Swap
description: Swaps user's and target's Attack and Special Attack stat stages.

name: Guard Swap
description: Swaps user's and target's Defense and Special Defense stat stages.

name: Baton Pass
description: Copies user's stat changes and most status effects to all other allies in the room.

name: Giga Impact
description: Greatly damages an enemy. User must rest for one turn after use.

name: Hyper Beam
description: Greatly damages an enemy. User must rest for one turn after use.

name: Snore
description: Damages all adjacent enemies. Used automatically while user is asleep if enemies are nearby.

name: Sleep Talk
description: Calls a random move that the user knows. Used automatically while user is asleep.

name: Ingrain
description: Ingrains user for 10-15 turns, preventing movement but quadrupling HP recovery.

name: Storm Throw
description: Damages an enemy. Always results in a critical hit.

name: Raging Bull
description: Damages an enemy and bypasses Counter, Reflect, Mirror Coat and Light Screen, ending their effects. Cuts corners.

name: Mist
description: Changes the floor's weather to Mist for 15-20 turns, preventing all stat drops.

name: Muddy Water
description: Damages all Pokémon in the room except the user. Considered to be both Water and Ground types. Has a 30% chance of lowering Accuracy by one level.

name: Freeze-Dry
description: Damages an enemy. Super effective against Water types and always freezes them. Otherwise, it has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

name: Sky Attack
description: Charges, then damages all enemies in a straight line up to 10 tiles away on next turn. Has a 30% chance of causing enemies to flinch. Has an increased critical hit chance.

name: Transform
description: Transforms the user into a copy of the target, copying their moves and stats. Wears off when changing floors.

name: Conversion
description: Changes user's type to a type combination that resists the last damaging move it was hit by.

name: Explosion
description: User faints and causes a huge explosion which damages all Pokémon and destroys items and terrain caught in the blast.

name: Self-Destruct
description: User faints and causes a explosion which damages all Pokémon and destroys items and terrain caught in the blast.

name: Rage Powder
description: Turns user into a Decoy. Enemies prioritize attacking decoys over other Pokémon.

name: Pay Day
description: Damages an enemy. Cuts corners. If this defeats an enemy, they will drop Poké.

name: Recycle
description: Recycles a Plain Seed in the inventory into a random seed or berry.
